Livello retribuzione di base 35.000,00 €/yr - 55.000,00 €/anno I nostri clienti non sono solo su LinkedIn: sono in tutta Italia, nelle associazioni di categoria, nei distretti industriali. Il tuo lavoro è portare lì Jet HR e trasformare ogni presenza in pipeline. Cosa farai Sarai la prima persona in Jet HR dedicata al 100% a eventi e field marketing. Non c'è un calendario, non ci sono format, non c'è un playbook: li costruirai tu. Gestisci gli eventi end to end. Progetti e organizzi i format di Jet HR e scegli gli eventi di terzi in cui vale la pena esserci. Concept, lista ospiti, inviti, location, fornitori, sponsorship, presenza on-site e follow-up: tutto in mano tua. Porta Jet HR sul territorio. Costruisci eventi on-site dove il nostro target lavora e si incontra: uffici, ristoranti, luoghi di categoria. Ti coordini con Partnerships, Sales e Growth. Coinvolgi il target. Definisci gli account target per città e verticale. Adatti ogni evento perché arrivi alle persone giuste con il messaggio giusto: inviti, esperienze 1:1, touchpoint. Rendi rilevante ogni attività. Adatti eventi e attività locali ai nostri verticali, così che ognuno raggiunga il target giusto con il messaggio giusto. Costruisci il playbook che Sales usa ogni giorno: gift kit, sequenze di inviti, template di follow-up. Dimostri l'impatto. Fissi i KPI prima di ogni attività e tracci tutto insieme a Marketing Ops. Quello che funziona diventa un playbook da portare in una nuova città o verticale senza ripartire da zero. Gestisci il budget. Costruisci il calendario annuale e gestisci plan vs actual, fornitori e contratti. Dici di no a quello che non ripaga. Chi cerchiamo Qualche anno di esperienza. 3-5 anni in event marketing, field o local marketing, o account-based marketing, meglio se B2B. Hai organizzato eventi end to end, propri e di terzi, e sai dire cosa hanno generato. Ownership del risultato. Vuoi che ogni evento sia memorabile, ma un evento non finisce quando esce l'ultimo ospite: finisce quando c'è la pipeline. Ti piacciono i numeri e li tracci, così sai sempre cosa ha portato ogni attività. Dai priorità a quello che muove il business. Problem solving sul momento. La location disdice, lo speaker è bloccato su un treno, metà degli ospiti conferma il giorno prima. Trovi il piano B, risolvi in tempo reale e nessuno in sala fa in tempo ad accorgersene. Ossessione per l'organizzazione. Location, fornitori, liste ospiti, logistica, scadenze, tutto su più città in contemporanea. Tratti ogni dettaglio come se il successo dell'evento dipendesse da quello, perché è così. Influenza cross-funzionale. Lavori fianco a fianco con Sales e li trasformi nei tuoi partner in crime: costruiscono la lista ospiti, si presentano e fanno follow-up, anche se nessuno di loro riporta a te. Valigia pronta. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale alla crescita di Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Porti le idee dal concept all'esecuzione in autonomia. Sei responsabile dell'output finale. Start-up environment. Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Lavoro ibrido. Abbiamo l'ufficio a Milano e ci aspettiamo che tu ci sia, con flessibilità. Senza essere fiscali, operiamo molto a buonsenso. Direct message the job poster from HEAD Watersports Giulia Cerutti Giulia Cerutti COMPANY BACKGROUND As a leading global player in the sports industry, HEAD Group offers exciting opportunities for ambitious talents eager to grow in a dynamic, innovative environment. Attracting, developing and retaining talented individuals is essential to our continued success. PURPOSE OF THE ROLE Drive profitable international DTC growth for Le Col, with a primary focus on hands-on paid media management across Google and Meta. Based in Milano, the role connects customer acquisition with CRM, affiliate and creator partnerships, and loyalty to improve conversion, repeat purchase and customer value. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Plan, build and optimise paid campaigns across Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, and Meta acquisition and retargeting. Manage campaign structures, audiences, bidding and placements against agreed market priorities and commercial targets. Manage day-to-day media budgets, pacing and forecasts within approved limits. Reallocate spend across campaigns and markets based on performance, marginal acquisition cost, product availability and promotional priorities; recommend changes to the overall investment plan. Drive continuous creative and campaign testing with Brand, Content and Ecommerce: develop briefs, test hooks, formats, copy, offers and landing pages, and turn results into clear actions that improve acquisition and conversion. Maintain reliable campaign measurement with IT, analytics specialists and agencies, including conversion events, product feeds, tracking links and consent-aware tracking. Diagnose discrepancies between platform reporting and ecommerce results. Own weekly performance reviews and monthly reporting across paid media and CRM. Evaluate CAC, ROAS, conversion and repeat purchase alongside net sales, discounts, returns and contribution; use cohort analysis and controlled tests to inform decisions beyond platform attribution. Manage the CRM campaign calendar, customer segmentation and automated journeys, including welcome, post-purchase, second-purchase and win-back. Coordinate email production and testing to improve retention and customer lifetime value. Manage affiliate activation with Digital Commerce and external partners: identify and onboard publishers, coordinate assets and offers, optimise partner activity and reconcile sales and commissions, accounting for returns, cancellations and duplicate attribution. Develop and coordinate commission-based influencer and content creator collaborations, including partner selection, briefs, product seeding, deliverables, links and codes. Coordinate approval of commercial terms, usage rights and disclosures; test creator content in paid campaigns where rights allow. Activate and optimise loyalty schemes, including Le Col Cycling Club: member onboarding, rewards, referrals and retention communications. Track participation, redemption and repeat purchase, and recommend improvements with the relevant teams. Coordinate agencies and specialist partners with clear briefs, deliverables and performance follow-up. Maintain CRM data quality, consent and suppression processes with Group CRM and IT, in line with shared standards. WHAT YOU BRING 3–5 years of relevant experience in performance marketing and digital growth for a DTC consumer brand or agency, ideally in premium apparel, cycling or sporting goods. Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns and media budgets, with evidence of improving acquisition efficiency and commercial results. Experience with Shopping feeds, Performance Max and creative testing is highly relevant. Strong analytical skills and practical experience with GA4, spreadsheets and campaign measurement. Able to interpret attribution differences and connect channel performance to customer acquisition costs and profitability. Practical experience with CRM campaigns, segmentation and automated journeys using Dotdigital or a comparable platform. Familiarity with affiliate networks, commission-based creator collaborations and loyalty programmes is an advantage. Proactive and commercially minded, with the ability to manage campaigns independently, prioritise tests and coordinate agencies and internal teams. Comfortable making recommendations and escalating material budget or performance issues. Fluent English and strong communication skills; Italian is an advantage. A genuine interest in cycling, premium apparel and the communities around them. BENEFITS A hands-on role with meaningful ownership of paid media performance and customer growth for Le Col within the HEAD Group. Close collaboration with Le Col Ecommerce, Brand and HEAD Group CRM and Digital Commerce specialists in an international sports business. The opportunity to shape acquisition, retention and partnership programmes from Milano, with clear commercial impact and professional development. This position is employed by HEAD Watersports S.p.A. and is permanently based in Milan, Italy. The role forms part of the HEAD Sportswear organisation in Italy and requires regular on-site collaboration with the relevant Milan-based teams.
